files.content: import pytest from markupsafe import Markup, escape, escape_silent def test_none_returns_empty_markup(): result = escape_silent(None) assert isinstance(result, Markup) assert str(result) == "" def test_false_is_escaped_like_escape(): result = escape_silent(False) assert isinstance(result, Markup) assert str(result) == "False" assert str(result) == str(escape(False)) def test_zero_is_escaped_like_escape(): result = escape_silent(0) assert isinstance(result, Markup) assert str(result) == "0" assert str(result) == str(escape(0)) def test_empty_string_returns_empty_markup(): result = escape_silent("") assert isinstance(result, Markup) assert str(result) == "" def test_special_characters_are_escaped(): result = escape_silent("") assert isinstance(result, Markup) assert str(result) == ( "<script>alert('x' & "y")</script>" ) def test_matches_escape_for_plain_text(): value = "hello world" assert str(escape_silent(value)) == str(escape(value)) assert str(escape_silent(value)) == "hello world" def test_existing_markup_not_double_escaped(): safe = Markup("bold") result = escape_silent(safe) assert isinstance(result, Markup) assert str(result) == "bold" def test_html_protocol_is_preserved(): class HasHtml: def __html__(self): return "safe" result = escape_silent(HasHtml()) assert isinstance(result, Markup) assert str(result) == "safe" def test_non_string_values_use_str(): result = escape_silent(123) assert isinstance(result, Markup) assert str(result) == "123" def test_ampersand_and_quotes_escaped(): result = escape_silent("a&b'c\"d") assert str(result) == "a&b'c"d"
